response.name: Net Worth Tracker API
response.description: Deterministic net-worth calculator. Sums assets and liabilities, computes net worth and the debt-to-asset ratio, breaks down each side by type, and benchmarks against the age×income/10 wealth target when age and income are supplied. Pure arithmetic — never estimated.

endpoints.summary: Compute net worth, ratios, and breakdowns

Net worth is 0.492× the age×income/10 benchmark (380000); increasing your savings rate is the fastest lever.
Re-run monthly to track the trend; net worth direction matters more than any single snapshot.

assumptions: Values are current market/face values you supplied at a single point in time.
Liquid assets count only entries typed "liquid" or "investment"; retirement and real estate are treated as illiquid.
The age×income/10 benchmark is a rough heuristic (Stanley & Danko), not a personalized target.

reasoning.why_result_generated: Subtracted 310000 in liabilities from 497000 in assets for a net worth of 187000.
invalidators: Stale or estimated asset values change net worth materially.
Excluding a liability (or asset) skews both the total and the ratio.
Illiquid assets (home, retirement) cannot cover near-term obligations despite raising net worth.
